surfaces.name: ORCH Ink TUI command center (orch / orch tui)
orch CLI and orch serve headless daemon

claims.answer: Terminal-only: an Ink TUI command center and the orch CLI (and a headless orch serve daemon) on macOS, Linux and WSL2 with Node >= 20. No desktop app, browser, mobile or editor extension.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension; a Claude Code /orch skill is installed instead.

task_actions.answer: Create, assign, run, cancel, approve, reject and retry tasks and message agents from CLI or TUI; TUI shows live activity.

notifications.answer: TUI shows toast banners; no push or OS notifications found.

limitations: Native Windows is not listed; no GUI, browser or phone client.

claims.answer: Eight adapters: Claude Code, OpenCode (any provider it supports), Codex, Pi, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity and shell (any command). Agents are spawned as local CLI child processes.

evidence.title: ORCH README
evidence.locator: Install; How your AI team works; Headless daemon; Full CLI reference; FAQ
evidence.finding: npm-installed orchestrator for parallel Claude, Codex, Pi, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity, OpenCode and shell agents: task state machine with mandatory review, isolated git worktrees, retry, teams, goals, org templates, messaging, orch serve daemon, file-based state in .orchestry, MIT, no cloud.

evidence.title: orch serve spec
evidence.finding: Headless daemon and CI mode specification for orch serve with JSON logs, lock and graceful shutdown.

evidence.title: MCP integration spec
evidence.finding: Draft proposal for an MCP adapter and an orch MCP server; marked not yet implemented.

evidence.title: Agent memory spec
evidence.finding: Exploratory design, not committed to the roadmap; states agents currently have no memory between runs beyond the key-value context store.

evidence.title: ORCH changelog
evidence.finding: Shipped changes per release up to 1.0.34.

evidence.title: MIT License
evidence.finding: MIT License covering the repository.

evidence.title: ORCH package manifest
evidence.finding: @oxgeneral/orch 1.0.34, MIT, bins orchestry/orch/ao, Node >= 20; dependencies chalk, commander, ink, js-yaml, liquidjs, nanoid, react; no analytics SDK or network client.

evidence.title: Task state machine
evidence.finding: Enforced transitions todo, in_progress, retrying, review, done, failed, cancelled; review gates done; tasks blocked by unfinished depends_on are not dispatched.

evidence.title: Task model
evidence.finding: Task has priority, assignee, labels, depends_on, attempts, max_attempts, workspace_mode, scope, review_criteria, feedback, goalId and attachments.

evidence.title: Config defaults
evidence.finding: Defaults: approval auto, max_turns 50, timeout 3,600,000 ms, stall 600,000 ms, worktree mode, max_attempts 3, poll 10 s, max_concurrent_agents 6, retry delay 10 s to 300 s.

evidence.title: Orchestrator tick
evidence.finding: Reconcile, dispatch, collect each tick; PID liveness, stall detection by per-agent timeout and retry queue; orphaned in_progress tasks repaired.

evidence.title: Dispatch
evidence.locator: dispatchAll with max_concurrent_agents (L748-L750); retry by max_attempts (L806)
evidence.finding: Dispatches dispatchable tasks up to available concurrency slots and retries while attempts remain.

evidence.title: Merge on approval
evidence.finding: Approved review tasks are merged back with the workspace manager.

evidence.title: Merge strategy
evidence.finding: git merge --no-ff of the task branch into the current branch; aborts and returns conflict info on conflict.

evidence.title: Workspace manager
evidence.finding: Creates a git worktree and branch per task (shared, worktree or isolated modes), reuses an existing worktree on retry and prunes on removal.

evidence.title: Review runner
evidence.finding: Runs review criteria test_pass (npm test), typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and lint (npm run lint) fail-fast to auto-review tasks that define them.

evidence.title: Scope overlap detection
evidence.finding: Tasks with overlapping glob scopes are detected by path-prefix comparison to avoid concurrent conflicting edits.

evidence.title: Claude adapter
evidence.finding: Runs claude --print style with --dangerously-skip-permissions because stdin is ignored.

evidence.title: Codex adapter
evidence.finding: Runs codex with --sandbox danger-full-access because autonomous agents cannot answer approval prompts.

evidence.title: Cursor adapter
evidence.finding: Runs the Cursor CLI with --yolo to bypass interactive prompts.

evidence.title: Adapter registry
evidence.finding: Adapters: claude, opencode, codex, pi, cursor, grok, antigravity and shell (any command).

evidence.title: Task CLI
evidence.locator: add, list, show, edit, assign, cancel, approve, reject, retry
evidence.finding: Task commands for creating, editing, assigning, cancelling, approving, rejecting and retrying tasks.

evidence.title: TUI review keys
evidence.finding: Tasks view approves or rejects the selected review task with single keys; TUI has Tasks, Agents and Actions tabs with live activity.

evidence.title: Message model
evidence.finding: Direct, broadcast and lead channels; messages are stored as JSON and injected into agent prompts at dispatch.

evidence.title: Org templates
evidence.finding: Pre-built team templates deployed with orch org deploy.

evidence.title: Storage paths
evidence.finding: All state lives in the project .orchestry directory as YAML, JSON and JSONL files.

evidence.title: Run model
evidence.finding: Runs record token usage; cache tokens are informational; no currency amounts.

evidence.title: Update check
evidence.finding: Update check runs npm view for the package version, cached for four hours; the only outbound request in the source.

evidence.title: Skills installer
evidence.finding: Bundled /orch skill is installed for Claude Code so natural-language requests become orch commands.

evidence.title: GitHub repository API
evidence.finding: Public repository oxgeneral/ORCH: 179 stars, MIT license, pushed 2026-08-01 (observed 2026-11-17).

evidence.title: ORCH v1.0.34 release
evidence.finding: Latest release v1.0.34 published 2026-08-01 at commit c066dc0; no release assets.

evidence.title: Bounded search: clients
evidence.finding: Only a CLI and an Ink TUI exist; the landing directory is a static marketing site; no server, desktop, web, mobile or editor client.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost and billing
evidence.finding: No currency cost, price table, budget or spend code; only token counters.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
evidence.finding: No users, accounts, roles, SSO or presence; a single local operator.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
evidence.finding: No cron, webhook or event triggers; the daemon polls tasks and seeds autonomous agent tasks.

evidence.title: Bounded search: remote execution
evidence.finding: No remote host, container or VM support; agents run as local child processes; docs say run orch serve under pm2 or systemd.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.finding: No telemetry or analytics code or dependency.

evidence.title: Bounded search: specs and docs retrieval
evidence.finding: No persistent product spec feature; review criteria are shell checks and the context store is key-value.

evidence.title: Task attachments
evidence.locator: CHANGELOG.md L802 and L643; src/cli/commands/task.ts --attach (L43); src/infrastructure/storage/paths.ts attachmentsDir (L84-L89)
evidence.finding: orch task add --attach stores files under .orchestry/attachments/<taskId>/, the TUI accepts pasted clipboard images and shows a paperclip indicator; no source code passes the attachments into an agent prompt (grep -rniE "attach" src outside TUI, CLI, task model and paths finds none).

evidence.title: Single-process lock and index mutex
evidence.finding: The PID lock is acquired only by orch run --watch and one-shot commands do not take it; index read-modify-write cycles are serialized by an in-process promise mutex, so there is no cross-process protection and no revision field for concurrent CLI and daemon writes.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: CPU and RAM awareness
evidence.finding: Only the serve logger reading the process heap size; no CPU or RAM limit or host awareness.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: pull requests and sync
evidence.finding: Only a code-reviewer role description in src/domain/agent-shop.ts; no PR creation, comment sync, push, pull or rebase code.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: dependency setup, caches and ports
evidence.finding: Matches are store index caches and the model list cache; no dependency installation, snapshot, service, port or secret handling for worktrees.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: rollback and revert
evidence.finding: Only an internal dispatch-claim rollback in orchestrator.ts and prompt text in agent-shop.ts; no task or merge revert feature.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: screenshots, recordings, artifacts
evidence.finding: Only the task --attach option text and a role prompt; no recording, preview or gallery feature.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: audit history and export
evidence.finding: Only team-template role names (security auditor); no audit log, activity history or data export command.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: indexing and retrieval
evidence.finding: No matches in src; no repository index or retrieval feature.

evidence.locator: Search of src/ (engine, CLI, TUI) and all package manifests (package.json and workspace manifests) for posthog, sentry, segment, amplitude, mixpanel, plausible, umami, telemetry, analytics, captureException, DO_NOT_TRACK
